description: Gold set for retrieval evaluation. For each query, the finding ids a human judge marks relevant, judged on CONTENT, never on what the retriever happens to rank highly. Revision history matters here: when Rosenheim 2026 was added, recall@3 fell from 0.79 to 0.71 — not because retrieval got worse, but because this file only listed the findings that existed when it was written, so genuinely relevant new findings counted as errors. The affected queries were re-judged by hand and newly relevant ids added; the retriever was NOT touched. Findings that merely ranked high without being relevant (e.g. the TRM and tissue-targeting findings surfacing for a baseline-sampling query) were deliberately NOT added. Queries added below exercise the new content.
